title: onprem: airgap offline bundle + vendor kube-distro support (rke2 / flatcar)
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add support for vendoring kube-distro images into the offline installer bundle. RKE2 and Flatcar-specific hooks added. Helm chart tweaks for air-gapped installs and upgrade path notes.
description: Problem: Customers running private/offline installations on RKE2 and Flatcar reported missing distro-specific artifacts in the offline bundle and manual steps during upgrades. This PR adds automated vendoring of distro assets into the airgap offline bundle, Helm chart compatibility fixes for cgroup driver and node annotations, terraform module updates to expose extra registry mirror options, and a lightweight upgrade/rollback helper to simplify staged upgrades in air-gapped environments. Changes include: 1) A new installer script installer/scripts/generate-offline-bundle.sh that vendors container images, kube-distro artifacts and CRI-related binaries into a versioned tarball. 2) vendor/ directory with curated RKE2 and Flatcar tarballs and provenance metadata (sha256 sums). 3) Helm chart changes in charts/onprem-installer/ to support imagePullSecrets, localRegistry mirror configuration, and optional systemd cgroup annotations required by some Flatcar kernels. 4) Terraform module adjustments in terraform/modules/onprem/ to expose registry mirror endpoints and node labels used by the Helm chart. 5) An upgrade helper scripts/upgrade-staged.sh that performs dry-run validation of offline bundles and provides an automatic rollback marker. 6) Docs updates in docs/airgap.md and templates/notes/upgrade.md describing the offline bundle format and upgrade steps. Testing: unit tests for bundle manifest generation, local e2e in a k3s VM and a RKE2 flatcar cluster via our perf-canary infra, and CI airgap integration tests were run. CI status: initial integration run failed on image mirror lookup (fixed by improving retry/backoff logic), subsequent run green. Security: vendored artifacts include verification metadata; installer verifies sha256 before apply. Upgrade notes: bundles are versioned by <release>-<bundle-hash>, upgrade helper writes a rollback-marker to /var/lib/redwood/installer/rollback-marker to allow automatic rollback to previous kubelet image and manifests. Checklist: - [x] generate offline bundle script - [x] vendor kube-distro artifacts - [x] Helm chart compatibility fixes - [x] terraform module knobs for mirror endpoints - [x] upgrade/rollback helper - [x] docs and release notes - [x] CI airgap tests - [x] security verification metadata Related: ENG-8732, PR #32894 (flatcar support prototype).

review_comments: Diego Morales (2026-01-15): Can we include checksum metadata per-asset and a verify step during extract? Author reply: Added scripts/verify-vendored-artifacts.sh and included sha256 metadata in vendor/MANIFEST. See commit d4e5f6a.

Priya Iyer (2026-01-18): Helm values schema changes look good, but ensure backward compatibility for existing values.yaml. Author reply: Added compatibility shims and migration notes in docs/airgap.md.

Samir Patel (2026-01-20): CI integration failed initially on mirror lookups. Are retries configurable? Author reply: Added configurable retry/backoff via BUNDLE_MIRROR_RETRY in generate-offline-bundle.sh and adjusted default to 5.
QA-Bot (2026-01-25): Integration tests flaky on flatcar node readiness, reduced kubelet cgroup probe timeout. Author reply: Increased probe timeout and added extra logging to help debug slow devices.

merge_result: Merged by Priya Iyer via squash and merge. Commit message: 'onprem: vendor rke2/flatcar artifacts and add offline bundle generator + helm/terraform compatibility (ENG-8732)'.
notes_for_backporters: This change introduces vendored distro artifacts and installer behavior changes. Backports should include scripts/verify-vendored-artifacts.sh, charts/onprem-installer values schema, and the manifest format change. Also ensure CI airgap job mirrors are available in target branches.
upgrade_instructions: Bundles are versioned and signed with sha256 in vendor/MANIFEST. To upgrade in air-gapped installs: 1) SCP bundle to bastion 2) run scripts/verify-vendored-artifacts.sh <bundle> to verify checksums 3) run scripts/upgrade-staged.sh apply <bundle> which will create a rollback-marker and perform staged rollout. See docs/airgap.md for full steps.
security_review: Vendored artifacts include sha256 sums and a verification step added. No new outbound network calls during apply by default; mirror queries only during bundle generation and are covered by retry/backoff and timeouts. Security reviewed by Security team (Priya Iyer).
additional_context: This PR was driven by multiple enterprise customers running air-gapped RKE2/Flatcar clusters and reduces manual steps required for installations and upgrades. It also standardizes the bundle format used by onprem support runbooks and the private installer helm chart.
